name: legend
title: Legend
description: One model for every key, value label and callout on a chart: a legend is a group of labels, and a label is text with an optional mark (a swatch or a stroke) and an optional plate (a pill's shape). Written `@legend{{Month 2 drop-off, tag, c4, for="Feb 2026 · M2"}}` for a label anchored to a mark, or `@legend{[{Poor, c1}, {Good, c3}], key}` for a key. A bare label, with no mark and no plate, is the default. Embedded, as the owner asked ("an embedded plugin similar to pills"): it loads on every render and has no off switch. Wave 0 of engineering/decisions/2026-10-19-universal-legend.md: the heatmap draws anchored labels; the other charts' keys move onto it one adopter at a time.
